We are looking for a seasoned AI Engineer (36 years experience) to lead the development of the intelligent layer for our proprietary platform, Querent
You will architect advanced RAG systems and Agentic workflows to transform messy, unstructured Electronic Health Records (EHR) into life-saving clinical insights
In this role, you will fine-tune both open-source and proprietary LLMs for medical domain specificity, ensuring high precision and reduced hallucinations in critical healthcare contexts
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy production-grade, HIPAA/GDPR-compliant models that directly impact patient outcomes, drug discovery, and clinical trials for million lives
If you are a Python expert with a deep background in LLM, GenAI, NLP, Vector Databases, and MLOps, we invite you to build the future of equitable, data-driven healthcare with us
Key Highlights for Your Outreach:The Tech Stack: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, LangChain/LlamaIndex, Pinecone/Milvus, and Cloud MLOps (AWS/Azure/GCP)
The Impact: Building the world's largest non-Caucasian oncology dataset to solve healthcare disparities
The Innovation: Implementing state-of-the-art Agentic AI and multi-modal clinical data structuring.
Location - Mumbai, Delhi / NCR, Bengaluru , Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Pune, Remote

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and innovative Generative AI Engineer to design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Python, AI/ML concepts, prompt engineering, vector databases, and cloud-native deployment architectures. The role involves building scalable GenAI solutions such as AI chatbots, copilots, intelligent search systems, document processing platforms, and AI automation workflows.


Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI applications using LLMs such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, or Mistral
Build and optimize RAG pipelines using embeddings and vector databases
Develop AI copilots, chatbots, document intelligence systems, and multi-agent workflows
Implement prompt engineering, function/tool calling, and AI orchestration frameworks
Fine-tune and evaluate foundation models for enterprise use cases
Integrate GenAI capabilities with APIs, databases, enterprise systems, and cloud platforms
Build scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI
Deploy and monitor AI applications on cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP
Implement LLMOps/MLOps practices including model monitoring, observability, governance, and evaluation
Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver AI solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices including security, hallucination mitigation, and data privacy


Requirements

Technical Skills

Strong programming skills in Python
Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI ecosystems
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI APIs, Hugging Face, AutoGen
Knowledge of RAG Architecture
Prompt Engineering
Embeddings
Vector Databases
AI Agents
Experience with vector DBs such as Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus
Understanding of ML/DL fundamentals and Transformer architecture
Experience with cloud services: AWS Bedrock / SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
Knowledge of SQL and NoSQL databases


Preferred Skills

Experience in fine-tuning LLMs using LoRA / QLoRA / PEFT
Exposure to multimodal AI systems
Knowledge of AI evaluation frameworks and observability tools
Experience with GPU optimization and inference tuning
Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI practices
Exposure to autonomous and agentic AI systems

We are seeking a highly skilled Generative AI (GenAI) Engineer with 412 years of overall technology experience and strong hands-on expertise in building and deploying production-grade GenAI solutions.
The ideal candidate should have experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI Agents, Python, Prompt Engineering, LangChain, LangGraph, embeddings, semantic search, and vector databases.
The role involves designing end-to-end GenAI solutions, developing RAG pipelines and AI agents, integrating models such as OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and Llama, and building AI services using Python and FastAPI/Flask.
The candidate will work with vector databases such as Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate, or Azure AI Search and deploy scalable AI applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Responsibilities also include LLM evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, security, responsible AI, performance optimization, and taking GenAI solutions from POC to production.

Roles and Responsibility
Design and develop generative AI models and algorithms to solve complex problems.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions into existing systems.
Develop and maintain large-scale data pipelines and architectures.
Conduct research and experimentation to improve AI model performance.
Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and develop tailored AI solutions.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and advancements in AI and machine learning.
Job Requirements
Strong foundation in computer science, mathematics, and statistics.
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++.
Experience with deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
Knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud.
Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Position: Generative AI Engineer

Job Type: Permanent

Role Overview

We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to build, optimize, and productionize cutting-edge AI systems. The role focuses on backend AI orchestration, framework integration, model performance, advanced RAG workflows, and multi-agent systems to deliver scalable, production-grade enterprise software.

Key Responsibilities

AI Orchestration: Build, test, and optimize bespoke Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent workflows.
Core Product Integration: Develop integration pipelines to embed core AI models into client environments.
Technical Delivery: Own the technical lifecycle of AI applications from rapid prototyping to stable production releases.
Optimization & Debugging: Perform technical debugging, root-cause analysis, and latency and prompt optimization.
Best Practices: Implement engineering best practices for LLM evaluation, guardrails, and version control.
Risk Management: Identify and flag model drift, data leakage, and system risks at an early stage.

Technical Requirements

GenAI Ecosystem: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production RAG pipelines and multi-agent systems using LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex.
Protocols & Frameworks: Strong understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP), A2A protocols, and Agent Developer Kits.
LLM Engineering: Practical proficiency in prompting techniques, fine-tuning workflows, and evaluating LLM outputs.
Data Science Stack: Strong hands-on experience with Python, pandas, scikit-learn, and PyTorch.
Cloud & MLOps: Experience deploying and scaling machine learning solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
DevOps & Containers: Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub Actions.
Backend Stack: Production-grade backend development skills in Python, with basic familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript for API integrations.

Role & responsibilities

Handson engineer to build Pythonbased GenAI and AWS Bedrock solutions, contributing to RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and production-ready AI features under senior guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Develop GenAI features and workflows using Python and AWS Bedrock
Implement RAG pipelines (chunking, embeddings, retrieval, grounding)
Build single/multi-step agent workflows using LangChain / LangGraph
Integrate LLMs with APIs, tools, and enterprise applications
Write tested, maintainable Python code with CI/CD pipelines
Monitor basic latency, token usage, and cost metrics
Collaborate with architects, seniors, and QA teams

MustHave Skills

Python - Core concepts: OOP, typing, modules, pytest/unittest, fixtures, basic async

AWS Bedrock - Model invocation (Claude/Titan, etc.), Knowledge bases or retrieval integration, basic understanding of guardrails & access controls

Generative AI - Prompting (system, few-shot), RAG types and approaches, Basic evaluation awareness, LangChain / LangGraph , Simple agent flows and routing

DevOps Basics - Git, PRs, CI pipelines, Docker basics, artifacts

Good to Have

Vector DB exposure (OpenSearch, FAISS, Pinecone, etc.), Kubernetes awareness, ML basics (metrics, crossval, leakage awareness), Understand requirements clearly, Good communication and learning mindset & Team-oriented execution.

Note: Apply only if you are available in Bangalore or ready to relocate .

Position Overview:

In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy AI-powered copilots and assistants that enhance user productivity, streamline workflows, and enable intelligent automation. You will work closely with product managers, data scientists, and backend engineers to build intelligent user experiences powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).
Responsibilities:
Build and deploy custom Generative AI copilots using LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, LLaMA, Mistral, etc.)

Integrate copilots into web/internal platforms via APIs or SDKs

Monitor latency, cost, and reliability metrics for deployed AI agents
Stay updated on GenAI tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Pinecone, Weaviate)

Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks
